# Capabilities

What an app author can use, generated from the tables the compiler dispatches on. `SPEC.md` is the contract for how each works.

## Playbooks (`brain guide <topic>`)

| Topic | What it covers |
|---|---|
| `start` | the working loop: spec → map → add → fix/check → test → doctor → build, which command when |
| `views` | routes from files, layouts, guards, 404/403, navigation |
| `data` | load, server functions, api() + resource(), channels, caching |
| `sockets` | liveResource: who can connect, its states, public pages, session changes |
| `forms` | form() schema, submit, server field errors, edit forms |
| `server` | sessions, server-only code, .brain_env, errors, deploy with brain start |
| `seo` | pick the target query first; answer-first pages for search and AI answers (GEO) |
| `a11y` | accessibility rules the build enforces and how to pass them first time |
| `webmcp` | exposing page actions to browser AI agents: when, names, descriptions |
| `tests` | colocated *.test.brain: mount, interact, assert every state |
| `i18n` | several languages: keys, plurals, formatting, localized routes |
| `performance` | measure, budgets, lazy components, images, long lists, workers |
| `llm` | ctx.llm: Anthropic and OpenAI from server code, keys, timeouts, server-side streaming |
| `ai` | Chrome's built-in AI (Gemini Nano) on the device: ai.ready, prompt, summarize, translate |
| `backend` | resources, policies, accounts and jobs on the native Rust/Postgres backend |
| `analytics` | what visitors actually do: reports, funnels, segments in the project's own Postgres |
| `migrate` | move an existing app to the installed compiler with brain upgrade |

## Native backend (`brain backend capabilities`)

| Field type | Example | Filters | Sortable |
|---|---|---|---|
| `str` | `str` | `eq` `ne` `in` `prefix` `iprefix` `exists` | yes |
| `num` | `num` |  | no |
| `bool` | `bool` | `eq` `exists` | yes |
| `email` | `email` | `eq` `ne` `in` `prefix` `iprefix` `exists` | yes |
| `obj` | `obj` |  | no |
| `geo` | `geo` | `near` `bbox` `exists` | no |
| `int` | `int` | `eq` `ne` `gt` `gte` `lt` `lte` `between` `in` `exists` | yes |
| `decimal(p,s)` | `decimal(10,2)` | `eq` `ne` `gt` `gte` `lt` `lte` `between` `in` `exists` | yes |
| `date` | `date` | `eq` `ne` `gt` `gte` `lt` `lte` `between` `in` `exists` | yes |
| `datetime` | `datetime` | `eq` `ne` `gt` `gte` `lt` `lte` `between` `in` `exists` | yes |
| `enum(a|b)` | `enum(a\|b)` | `eq` `ne` `in` `prefix` `iprefix` `exists` | yes |
| `list<str>` | `list<str>` | `has` `exists` | no |
| `ref:<resource>` | `ref:posts` | `eq` `ne` `in` `exists` | no |
| `org` | `org` | `eq` `ne` `in` `exists` | no |

Field options: `required` `default` `unique` `on_delete` `visible` `access` `slug` `pattern`.

Filter operators: `eq` `ne` `gt` `gte` `lt` `lte` `between` `in` `prefix` `iprefix` `exists` `has` `near` `bbox`.

Policy operations: `read` `create` `update` `delete`.

Policy grants: `public` `owner` `owner.<ref>` `org` `org.<role>` `org.own` `<role>`.
